title: 第10章 杀丁泰
slug: 穿梭时空的侠客全本免费-穿梭时空的侠客最新章节列表
content_zh:
“我忘了！”陈浩有些不好意思的说道，手枪它自然带了来，只不过放在了储物空间，眼下好不容易遇到几个高手，他想用武功和他们较量一番，也好看看自己的实力究竟如何。
沈炼“......”。
沈炼差点没被陈浩气吐血，来时我千叮咛万嘱咐让你带火器，现在你说你忘了！
“沈大人看来是不见棺材不落泪了！”丁白缨左手将长刀半举在空中，淡漠的说道：“既然沈大人不愿意束手就擒，那只好做过一场了！”
长刀出鞘，丁白缨将刀鞘扔在了地上，双手持刀直指身前的沈炼，至于没有火器的陈浩完全不被她放在眼里。
陈浩用手枪杀凌云恺的消息北斋昨夜就告诉了丁白缨，之后丁白缨便通过陆文昭的关系调查了沈氏兄弟。
得到的消息是沈炼武艺高强，沈长青武力很差，只不过是仰仗着火器之利才杀了凌云恺，而今没有携带火器的沈长青在他们眼里和三岁的孩童没什么两样。
丁白缨拔刀的同时那女孩丁翀也从盾牌里抽出了一把刀，那大汉丁泰手持狼牙棒狞笑着盯着沈炼，三人全将沈炼视为危险人物，陈浩俨然就是一枚酱油党。
“跑!”
沈炼骤然间出手，使出一招“横扫三军”一把绣春刀竟同时攻向了三个人，出招时还喊了一声跑，很明显想自己缠住三人，给陈浩跑路的机会。
“狂妄！”
丁翀讥笑一声，手中长刀往上一横便挡住了沈炼狠辣的攻势，不过她也被沈炼刀上力量给震退了两步。
“去死！”
见师妹吃了点小亏，丁泰怒吼一声，手中的狼牙棒重重的砸向沈炼的头顶，而丁白缨却没有出手，她似乎对两个徒弟很有信心。
沈炼当然看到了丁泰的招式，他飞快的将绣春刀往上举，准备格挡住呼啸而来的狼牙棒，正在此时，丁翀也瞅准机会砍向了沈炼，被两人夹击，沈炼立时倍感压力。
就在这时陈浩出手了！
刀棒相击，传出了巨大的响声。
沈炼有些难以置信，堂弟沈长青居然在他之前挡住了丁泰的狼牙棒，还将丁泰震退了几步。
丁翀更是惊讶之极，甚至连砍向沈炼的刀都慢了几分。
又是一声响，沈炼与丁翀对劈了一刀，之后两人都往后退了两步，眼睛同时看向陈浩。

丁白缨先是一惊，随即又冷冷一笑，道：“隐藏的够深的，不过这些还不够！”
沈炼则是一脸喜色，他知道堂弟隐藏了一些在广州时的秘密，但没想到居然隐藏的那么深！
“你这是边军的功夫！”陈浩神情冷漠的将绣春刀拖在身后，摆了一个比较拉风的姿势，他哪懂啥边军不边军的，这句话是电影里沈炼的台词，被他拿出了装B用了。
“咦，你倒是识货，不过边军不好玩，老子改行做流寇了！”丁泰这人纯属肌肉发达头脑简单类型的，陈浩稍微一说，他就把自己的老底给泄露了。
“当流寇就好玩？”陈浩本能的问道。
“当然了，自从当了流寇，老子干了几个小媳妇大闺女了，干完还不用负责任，直接就杀了，连埋都不用埋，边军哪有这待遇......”
“师兄！”丁翀俊脸通红，她没想到师兄会说这种混话，气愤的说道：“师兄你怎么能这样，是不是那姓李的把你教坏的？”
丁泰也发觉自己说错话了，他挠了挠头道：“李大哥是好人，他是为我好。”
“哼！”丁白缨冷哼了一声，心里对丁泰有些失望。
找死！方才陈浩还觉得丁泰这位大汉有点意思，现在却是杀意纵横。
他生平最恨欺凌弱小，特别是欺辱妇女的人，就算不为侠客点陈浩也要杀了他，更何况杀了他之后肯定会获得侠客点，简直一举两得。
这时沈炼对陈浩使了一个眼神，他先是看了看丁翀和丁泰，然后又瞄了一眼丁白缨，陈浩瞬间看懂了他的意思，他是想让陈浩拖住丁翀和丁泰，他来对付丁白缨，想要擒贼先擒王。
陈浩对沈炼点了下头示意可以，他也没去提醒沈炼注意丁白缨锋利的长刀，他知道丁白缨这时候不会杀了沈炼。
得到陈浩回复，沈炼立时使出一招“力劈华山”，他距离丁白缨不出十步，脚下运用八步赶蝉眨眼间就到了丁白缨身前。

content_en:
"I forgot!" Chen Hao said with some embarrassment. He naturally brought the pistol but put it in the storage space. Now he finally met a few masters. He wanted to compete with them in martial arts and see how strong he was.
Shen Lian "...".
Shen Lian almost vomited blood because of Chen Hao's anger. When I came here, I told you to bring firearms, but now you say you forgot!
"Master Shen seems to have stopped crying without seeing the coffin!" Ding Baiying half-raised the long knife in the air with her left hand and said indifferently: "Since Master Shen is not willing to surrender, we have to do it again!"
After unsheathing the long sword, Ding Baiying threw the scabbard to the ground and pointed the sword directly at Shen Lian in front of her. As for Chen Hao, who had no firearm, she did not take it seriously at all.
Beizhai told Ding Baiying the news that Chen Hao shot Ling Yunkai with his pistol last night, and then Ding Baiying investigated the Shen brothers through Lu Wenzhao's relationship.
The news they received was that Shen Lian was very skilled in martial arts, while Shen Changqing was poor in martial arts. He only killed Ling Yunkai with the help of firearms. Now, Shen Changqing, who was not carrying a firearm, was no different from a three-year-old child in their eyes.
When Ding Baiying drew the sword, the girl Ding Chong also drew a sword from the shield. The big man Ding Tai held the mace and stared at Shen Lian with a ferocious smile. All three of them regarded Shen Lian as a dangerous person, and Chen Hao seemed to be a soy sauce gangster.
"Run!"
Shen Lian suddenly took action and used a move to "sweep the three armies". An Xiuchundao attacked three people at the same time. When he made the move, he yelled to run away. It was obvious that he wanted to entangle the three of them and give Chen Hao a chance to escape.
"Arrogant!"
Ding Chong sneered and raised the long knife in his hand to block Shen Lian's fierce attack, but she was also knocked back two steps by the power of Shen Lian's knife.
"Go to hell!"
Seeing that his junior sister suffered a small loss, Ding Tai roared angrily and hit Shen Lian's head with the mace in his hand, but Ding Baiying did not take action. She seemed to be very confident in her two apprentices.
Of course, Shen Lian saw Ding Tai's move. He quickly raised the Xiuchundao, preparing to block the roaring mace. At this moment, Ding Chong also saw the opportunity and slashed at Shen Lian. Being flanked by the two, Shen Lian immediately felt the pressure.
At this moment Chen Hao took action!
The swords and sticks struck each other, making a loud noise.
Shen Lian was a little unbelievable that his cousin Shen Changqing actually blocked Ding Tai's mace before him and knocked Ding Tai back a few steps.
Ding Chong was even more surprised, and even the knife he slashed at Shen Lian was a little slower.
There was another sound, and Shen Lian and Ding Chong slashed at each other. After that, they both took two steps back and looked at Chen Hao at the same time.
Ding Baiying was startled at first, then smiled coldly and said: "Hiding is deep enough, but this is not enough!"
Shen Lian looked happy. He knew that his cousin had hidden some secrets from his time in Guangzhou, but he didn't expect it to be so deep!
"This is the skill of the border army!" Chen Hao dragged the Xiuchundao behind him with an indifferent expression, and posed in a more fashionable pose. He didn't know what the border army was or not. This sentence was Shen Lian's line in the movie, and he used it to show off.
"Hey, you know your stuff, but the frontier army is not fun. I have changed my career to become a bandit!" Ding Tai is a muscular and simple-minded person. Chen Hao just said a little and he revealed his background.
"Is it fun to be a bandit?" Chen Hao asked instinctively.
"Of course, since I became a gangster, I have fucked several young wives and older girls. I don't have to take responsibility after doing it. I just kill them without even burying them. How can the frontier soldiers get such treatment..."
"Senior brother!" Ding Chongjun's face turned red. She didn't expect that her senior brother would say such nonsense, and said angrily: "Senior brother, how could you do this? Did the man named Li teach you bad things?"
Ding Tai also realized that he had said the wrong thing. He scratched his head and said, "Brother Li is a good person. He is doing it for my own good.""Humph!" Ding Baiying snorted coldly, feeling a little disappointed in Ding Tai.
court death! Just now, Chen Hao thought that Ding Tai, a big man, was a bit interesting, but now he has murderous intent.
He hated bullying the weak the most in his life, especially those who bullied women. Even if Chen Hao didn't gain knighthood points, he would still kill him. What's more, after killing him, he would definitely gain knighthood points. It was like killing two birds with one stone.
At this time, Shen Lian glanced at Chen Hao. He first looked at Ding Chong and Ding Tai, and then at Ding Baiying. Chen Hao instantly understood what he meant. He wanted Chen Hao to hold Ding Chong and Ding Tai down while he dealt with Ding Baiying. He wanted to capture the thief first and capture the king first.
Chen Hao nodded to Shen Lian to indicate that it was okay. He did not remind Shen Lian to pay attention to Ding Baiying's sharp long knife. He knew that Ding Baiying would not kill Shen Lian at this time.
After receiving Chen Hao's reply, Shen Lian immediately used the move "Strike Huashan". He was less than ten steps away from Ding Baiying, and he used eight steps to catch the cicada and arrived in front of Ding Baiying in the blink of an eye.
